label: OmniTIK 5
description: MikroTik OmniTIK 5 (RBOmniTikU-5HnD) — 5x 100M RJ45, Wi-Fi 5 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core AR9344.
notes: Inlet is `eth1`, and it is the board's only power socket - the OmniTIK 5 has no PoE-out. https://mikrotik.com/product/RBOmniTikU-5HnDr2 (read 2026-11-28): "Number of DC inputs 1 (PoE-IN)", "PoE in Passive PoE", "PoE in input Voltage 11-30 V", "Max power consumption 11 W", and no PoE-out row. https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/omnitik-series/ adds "Ethernet port accepts passive PoE 12-57 V DC. For Omnitik 5 models, 11-30 V" but names no port; the RouterBOARD quick guide for this model does - "OmniTik accepts 8-30V Passive PoE on WAN port (ether1)" (https://download.discomp.cz/MikroTik/QG/OmniTik-U-5HnD-qg.pdf). https://cdn.mikrotik.com/web-assets/product_files/omnitik_201106.pdf prints "Power input Passive 11-30V PoE in only" and lists PoE output for the UPA only. 11 W is the published ceiling. The row used to spell the schema-illegal `poeIn: true` here and leave eth2-eth5 silent, so the engine guessed 12.95 W on each: 51.8 W asked of a PSE by an 11 W board.
